title: Astronomy: From Sky to Cosmos
description: Track the turning sky, weigh a planet, take a star's temperature and time the expanding universe, with real numbers throughout.
audience: An adult comfortable with algebra, powers of ten and ratios. Physics: Motion and Forces helps but is not required.

modules.title: The sky in motion
modules.summary: The turning sky, the seasons, the Moon's phases and eclipses.

concepts.title: The turning sky
concepts.summary: Use latitude and declination to predict where a star climbs, and whether it ever sets.

concepts.title: Why the seasons change
concepts.summary: Explain the seasons from Earth's tilt and calculate the noon height of the Sun.

concepts.title: Phases and eclipses
concepts.summary: Relate the Moon's phase to the Sun–Earth–Moon angle and explain when eclipses happen.

modules.title: Gravity and orbits
modules.summary: Kepler's laws, Newton's gravitation, orbital and escape speed, tides.

concepts.title: Kepler's laws
concepts.summary: Describe an orbit by its size and shape, and link its period to its semi-major axis.

concepts.summary: Use the inverse-square law of gravity to compare forces and compute surface gravity.

concepts.title: Orbits, escape and tides
concepts.summary: Compute circular and escape speeds and explain tides as a difference in pull.
